annotation.title_clean: National Artificial Intelligence Research and Development Strategic Plan: 2023 Update
annotation.title_en: National Artificial Intelligence Research and Development Strategic Plan: 2023 Update
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence, National Science and Technology Council (OSTP), United States
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: The 2023 update of the US National AI R&D Strategic Plan reaffirms eight strategies and adds a ninth on international collaboration. It guides federal AI research investment on responsible, trustworthy AI, safety, standards, workforce and partnerships. Robotics appears in one subsection; regulation is explicitly left to other documents.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds Strategy 9: principled, coordinated international collaboration in AI research.
Strategy 1 includes a section on developing more capable, reliable and safe robots, including human-robot collaboration.
Strategies 3 and 4 prioritise research on ethical, legal and societal implications and AI safety and security.
Strategy 6 calls for AI standards, benchmarks, testbeds and auditing, informed by the AI Bill of Rights blueprint and NIST AI RMF.
Plan leaves regulation and governance to other federal documents; proposes metrics to evaluate agency implementation.
